(6) In this Act “relevant en forcement officer” means—
(a) a police or customs offi cer (see section 36(4)), or
(b) an officer of a local authority.

40 Further provision about search warrants

(1) An application for a search warrant ma y be made without notice being given
to persons who might be affected by the warrant.

(2) The application must be supported—
(a) in England and Wales, by an information in writing;
(b) in Scotland, by evidence on oath;
(c) in Northern Ireland, by a complaint on oath.
Psychoactive Substances Act 2016 (c. 2)26

(3) A person applying for a search warrant must answer on oath any question that
the justice hearing the application asks the person.
In the case of an application made by a procurator fiscal, that requirement may
be met by a relevant enforcement officer.
